admin.hook_decisions.column.decided_at.description: Column of the list of decisions: when the review answered.

admin.hook_decisions.column.details.description: Column of the list of decisions: the wait, reason, note, and cancellation.

admin.hook_decisions.column.hook.description: Column of the tables of the automated reviews screen: which external review.

admin.hook_decisions.column.mode.description: Column of the tables of the automated reviews screen: off, observe, or enforce.

admin.hook_decisions.column.outcome.description: Column of the list of decisions: the verdict, or the kind of failure.

admin.hook_decisions.column.outcomes.description: Column of the table of external reviews: the counts of decisions per outcome.

admin.hook_decisions.column.subject.description: Column of the list of decisions: what identifies the post, follow, sign-up, or file.

admin.hook_decisions.empty.description: Empty list of decisions: no external review stopped anything or failed.

admin.hook_decisions.filter.all.description: Option of the select that keeps the decisions of one external review: every review.

admin.hook_decisions.filter.label.description: Accessible name of the select that keeps the decisions of one external review.

admin.hook_decisions.hook.inbound_follow.description: Name of the external review of follows that arrive from other servers.

admin.hook_decisions.hook.inbound_status.description: Name of the external review of posts that arrive from other servers.

admin.hook_decisions.hook.local_status.description: Name of the external review of posts by accounts of this server.

admin.hook_decisions.hook.media_check.description: Name of the external review of uploaded media.

admin.hook_decisions.hook.signup_check.description: Name of the external review of sign-ups.

admin.hook_decisions.latency.description: Term of a decision: how long the call of the review took.

admin.hook_decisions.latency.value.description: Value of how long the call of the review took, in milliseconds.

admin.hook_decisions.list.title.description: Heading of the list of decisions on the automated reviews screen, and the caption of its table.

admin.hook_decisions.menu.defaultMessage: What the external reviews stopped or could not check.
admin.hook_decisions.menu.description: Summary of the automated reviews screen in the moderation menu.

admin.hook_decisions.mode.enforce.description: Mode of an external review: it acts on the verdict.

admin.hook_decisions.mode.observe.description: Mode of an external review: it records the verdict and acts on nothing.

admin.hook_decisions.mode.off.description: Mode of an external review: it calls nothing.

admin.hook_decisions.not_configured.description: Mode cell of an external review that has no plugin on this server: it calls nothing.

admin.hook_decisions.note.description: Term of a decision: the short plain-text note the review left for moderators.

admin.hook_decisions.outcome.allow.description: Outcome of a decision: the review let it through.

admin.hook_decisions.outcome.breaker_ope.description: Outcome of a decision: the server skipped the review after repeated failures. A failure, not a verdict.

admin.hook_decisions.outcome.drop.description: Outcome of a decision: the review stopped it and nothing is stored.

admin.hook_decisions.outcome.error.description: Outcome of a decision: the call of the review failed. A failure, not a verdict.

admin.hook_decisions.outcome.flag.description: Outcome of a decision: the review let it through and files a report.

admin.hook_decisions.outcome.invalid.description: Outcome of a decision: the answer of the review was outside its vocabulary. A failure, not a verdict.

admin.hook_decisions.outcome.mark_sensit.description: Outcome of a decision: the review let it through and its attachments show as sensitive.

admin.hook_decisions.outcome.reject.description: Outcome of a decision: the review refused it.

admin.hook_decisions.outcome.require_app.description: Outcome of a decision: the review holds a sign-up for approval.

admin.hook_decisions.outcome.timeout.description: Outcome of a decision: the call of the review ran past its deadline. A failure, not a verdict.

admin.hook_decisions.overridden.description: Status message after a moderator cancelled a decision.

admin.hook_decisions.overridden_at.description: Term of a decision: when a moderator cancelled it.

admin.hook_decisions.override.description: Button of a row of the list of decisions: cancels the decision.

admin.hook_decisions.override_action.description: Accessible name of the button that cancels a decision. {hook} names the review, {outcome} the outcome, and {date} when it decided.

admin.hook_decisions.override_failed.description: Toast when cancelling a decision failed. {reason} says why.

admin.hook_decisions.reason.description: Term of a decision: the coded reason the review gave.

admin.hook_decisions.summary.count.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {# decision} other {# decisions}}, {average} ms on average, {max} ms at most
admin.hook_decisions.summary.count.description: Value of a count of decisions, with how long the calls took in milliseconds.

admin.hook_decisions.summary.none.description: Cell of the table of external reviews: a review that made no decisions in the period.

admin.hook_decisions.summary.outcome.description: Term of a count of decisions. {outcome} is what the review answered; {mode} is the mode it ran in.

admin.hook_decisions.summary.period.defaultMessage: Counts and waits of the last 7 days.
admin.hook_decisions.summary.period.description: Note above the table of external reviews: the period the numbers cover.

admin.hook_decisions.summary.title.description: Heading of the section of the automated reviews screen with one row per external review.

admin.hook_decisions.title.description: Heading and menu entry of the moderation screen that lists what the external reviews of submissions said.
